summary: OpenAI's CEO comments on rapid growth in usage/demand ('5.6x sol growth'), praises the inference team for scaling to meet it, and warns of possible service hiccups as scaling continues.

mechanisms.reason: The post states large growth in usage and that the inference team is straining to keep up with demand, implying rising inference volume, though the exact metric ('5.6 sol growth') is not clearly defined.
mechanisms.quote: the inference team has done heroic work to be able to support demand.
